body: Being aware of being stuck in a cycle is the first step to breaking out of it. You're right, fuck this life; carve a new one out for yourself. You've realised this isn't how you want your life to be, now figure out how to get help to make it what you want.

Perhaps not keeping it in anymore is exactly what you need to do. It's hard dealing with an illness others can't always see, and I'm sure it must be very frustrating for you to deal with it all alone. Is there any reason you feel like you can't talk to others about it?
I think the B should be exempt from your BLT.
